raw_proposal.draft:
Dear [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your workflow has stopped after a configuration change, and we appreciate your prompt communication. Our support team is currently looking into your issue and will be in touch shortly to assist you further.

Once the current issue is resolved, we would be happy to discuss any potential expansion opportunities with you.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Support Team
[Contact Information]
